title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 2.00 (quiet) at 14:00 UTC on 9 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 9 日 14:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 2.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 2.00 (2Z) at 14:00 UTC on 9 October 2026. The 14 hour is complete (60 samples through 14:59; hour-start 2.00/2Z, hour-end 2.00/2Z). Last-180 maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-10-09T12:58:00Z; label 2Z). Published-window maximum is 4.00 (first at 2026-10-09T10:00:00Z; label 4Z). Window starts 2026-10-09T10:00:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 4.00. The 15 UTC hour on 9 October is incomplete (58 samples through 15:57).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
